notes: Two new brag cards in Stats: your rarest achievements (choose the six it shows), and what your collection costs at today's store prices on Steam, GOG, Epic, PlayStation and Nintendo. Right-click a game and choose Change poster to pick a better one from its stores, SteamGridDB or a file of your own; with a free SteamGridDB key, games with only square art or none get full-size posters automatically. The library bar's filters are icons now, plus a No art filter for the games still showing a Showcase cover. Also: Nintendo syncs again after Nintendo changed its purchase history page, Epic covers are shown whole, Steam achievements that share an icon are matched by name, and What's new shows an update's notes and date inside Showcase.
